purpose: Skip-and-fill 50-record batch 106 from the clean 611-record reference-dependent queue. The batch preserves source-specific alternate printings and locks several same-batch dependency chains (Snowshoes, Silence, Vine Mine, Make Manifest, and Tormenting Thirst/Symbol of Thirst). Every selected record was manually source-inspected; ambiguous cross-edition inheritance, truncated sources, and unresolved summon/stat-block-heavy records were deferred rather than forced.

spells/ice-knife-3883.name: Ice Knife
spells/ice-knife-3883.effectSummary: Launches one icy missile at long range with a normal ranged attack and a +2 bonus on the attack roll per two caster levels. A hit deals 2d8 cold damage plus 2 Dexterity damage; a successful Fortitude save negates the Dexterity damage, and creatures immune to cold are automatically immune to that Dexterity damage. If the attack misses, the knife bursts where it lands in a 10-foot radius for 1d8 cold damage, Reflex half. Material component: a drop of water or piece of ice.
spells/ice-knife-3883.notes: Spell Compendium printing kept source-distinct from the Complete Arcane and Oriental Adventures/Tome and Blood versions.

provenance.role: primary Spell Compendium catalog record and digest source

spells/listening-coin-4377.name: Listening Coin
spells/listening-coin-4377.effectSummary: Turns a pair of coins into a remote audio sensor and receiver for 1 hour per caster level. Hearing through the receiver lets you listen to the sensor's surroundings as if present there; if the sensor is inside a pocket, pouch, or sack, Listen checks are made at +5 DC. The coins function at any distance on the same plane but fall silent if separated across planes.

provenance.role: primary Spell Compendium catalog record and digest source

spells/spectral-weapon-4202.name: Spectral Weapon
spells/spectral-weapon-4202.effectSummary: Creates one quasi-real melee weapon of any type with which you are proficient for 1 round per caster level. Only you can wield it, and attacks with it are resolved as melee touch attacks. A creature hit can make a Will save to disbelieve; success reduces normal weapon damage to one-half and gives only a 50% chance that special attack effects delivered through that hit or later hits from the same weapon affect it. The weapon disappears if you release it or the duration ends.
spells/spectral-weapon-4202.notes: Spell Compendium printing intentionally preserves its one-half damage/50% disbelief rules rather than importing the Complete Adventurer printing's different fractions.

provenance.role: primary Spell Compendium catalog record and digest source

spells/terra-cotta-warrior-2128.name: Terra Cotta Warrior
spells/terra-cotta-warrior-2128.effectSummary: Transforms a small terra-cotta warrior statuette into a Medium animated object for 1 round per caster level. The construct has speed 40 feet, hardness 6, and none of the animated-object special attack forms. You direct it as the spell allows. If the statuette remains intact when the spell ends it can be reused; if destroyed, it must be repaired or replaced. Focus: a terra-cotta warrior statuette worth at least 1 gp.
spells/terra-cotta-warrior-2128.notes: Older Oriental Adventures printing kept source-distinct; unlike the later Complete Arcane version, its source delegates the remaining animated-object statistics rather than restating them.

You can also track by scent, using Wisdom against DC 10 for a fresh trail with +2 DC per hour of age and other odor/number modifiers, while ignoring surface and visibility conditions.

If created for guard duty, they instead remain for 7 months, must guard a fixed site, and cannot move beyond the spell's range from that site. spells/silence-2704.name: Silence

spells/symbol-of-thirst-3153.name: Symbol of Thirst
spells/symbol-of-thirst-3153.effectSummary: Functions as symbol of death's symbol/trap chassis, but when triggered it affects creatures within 60 feet with tormenting thirst for 10 minutes per caster level rather than killing by Hit Dice. A rogue can find and disable it as a magic trap with DC 25 + spell level, or DC 32 for this spell. Material components include mercury and phosphorus plus powdered diamond and opal worth at least 5,000 gp.
spells/symbol-of-thirst-3153.notes: Symbol of Death was already reviewed; Tormenting Thirst is locked in this same batch.

provenance.role: primary Sandstorm catalog record and digest source
Player's Handbook v.3.5 source for inherited Symbol of Death mechanics
Sandstorm source for inherited Tormenting Thirst mechanics

spells/searing-exposure-3159.name: Searing Exposure
spells/searing-exposure-3159.effectSummary: Exposes one living creature to supernatural desert heat. On a failed Fortitude save it takes 1d4 nonlethal damage per caster level, maximum 15d4, and becomes dazzled, dehydrated, and sunburned; nonlethal damage beyond its hit points becomes lethal as normal. A successful save halves the damage, still causes dehydration, and dazzles the target for 1d4+1 rounds. Heat-protection gear grants +4 on the save; heavy clothing or armor instead imposes -4 but prevents sunburn. Material component: a shard of glass.

provenance.role: primary Sandstorm catalog record and digest source
